4 rashers streaky bacon ≈ 100g total; pan-fried, fat rendered but still included in totals.
100g fresh spinach used as topping/greens (modest quantity for 'topping' on 4 servings).
100g frozen or fresh peas used as topping/greens (modest quantity for 'topping' on 4 servings).
